name: MMD1_MC_5/3
definition: A compression technique applying 1D MMD in the x direction, 1D integer wavelet transform in the y direction, and the MC_5/3 filter in the inter-slice direction, coded with 3D SPIHT.
summary: MMD1_MC_5/3 is a lossless volumetric compression technique for 3D medical images that uses 1D MMD in the x-direction, 1D integer wavelet in the y-direction, and motion-compensated filtering in the z-direction.
